g.text: Choose the frequency. Check the quotient pairing.
Exact Fourier geometry and an exact removed-point example
Left: a repeating envelope for centers 2πj + π/12; only the marked decimal is numerical.
Right: δ₀ vanishes on Y but detects this smooth closure-supported test. The arrow shows evaluation, not a delta density.
